name: Plan and subscription operations

requirements.text: Authorized billing administrators manage plan catalog metadata, Stripe mappings, and explicit workspace overrides.
Admin overrides require actor, reason, source, optional expiry, and an immutable audit record.
Stripe-owned subscription state changes continue through Cashier and Stripe rather than local imitation.

externalPrerequisites: Stripe credentials for live subscription operations

acceptanceCriteria.text: Plan and subscription mutations require admin.billing.manage and produce redacted audit records.
An override is visibly distinct from provider-owned subscription state and expires predictably.

observedBehaviors: Plans are listed with price and plan-state metadata.
A plan-management action appears in the toolbar.
Subscriptions appear in a table with account, plan, status, and date metadata.
